answer: In PoA, each identity must lock bonded collateral, making a hollow swarm costly to maintain. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting statements, correlated-slashing exposure grows as O(k^2), because pairwise evidence links multiply penalties across the cluster. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier further compounds confiscation and asymmetric depreciation, so sybil control becomes economically irrational. A glacier-paced attacker gains no refuge, while juniper-linked identities remain jointly accountable.
